scope: Owner pump only: background timers and the boot stability commit (screen-off) on the UI owner loop. No L2 transport: SAR RX/session/crypto/send are not recovered for this target.
constraints: uv_timer_init/start mutate owner-loop lists and heaps; only the LVGL bootstrap callback on the UI owner initializes and starts the resident handle, and its callbacks run on that loop. No threads or work queues.
Static recovery from the exact firmware IDB plus Mirage emulator runs; no physical-device validation yet.
